scenarios.name: colored-mana-unavailable-without-basic-land-or-entry-this-turn
scenarios.why: The Fortress entered before turn one, and controlling only this nonbasic land does not satisfy the alternative basic-land condition.

scenarios.name: colored-mana-offered-while-controlling-basic
scenarios.why: The player controls a basic land, which satisfies the ability's second alternative condition.

scenarios.name: colored-mana-activates-with-basic-land
scenarios.why: With a basic Swamp under control, the restricted ability is legal and its activation adds black mana.

scenarios.name: colorless-mana-activates-unrestricted
scenarios.why: The colorless-producing ability carries no restriction; activating it taps the Fortress and adds colorless mana even with no basic land controlled.
